The Consiglio della Fondazione Dr. Vittorio e Dr. Teresa Cornaro offers scholarships to young Swiss or foreign citizens residing in the Canton Ticino, with preference given to those originally from or currently residing in Lugano, who are planning to attend university courses in Economics (Bachelor's degree).
